title: Reset a component's state with key

slides.say: Want to reset all of a component's state? You don't need an effect. You need a key.

slides.text: Switch contact → old draft text stays! 😬
slides.say: When you switch contacts, React sees the same component in the same place, so it keeps the old draft message.
Give it a key. When the key changes, React throws away the old component and its state, and mounts a fresh one.

slides.text: key isn't just for lists. It tells React: this is a different thing.
slides.say: Keys aren't just for lists. A key tells React: this is a different thing now.
